::: {.dashboard-note}
PRISM percentile ranks compare matching periods in 1991–2020. Low precipitation ranks indicate drier conditions. Temperature departure is in °F; positive values mean warmer conditions. A high dry-spell rank means an unusually long ongoing dry spell. These indicators describe conditions, not a combined drought classification.

Water-year precipitation starts October 1. Early-season ranks describe a short period; use the 90-day map for broader context.
:::
